scope: Six roots on the previously used MT25_rep3 slide. Development demonstration, not an independent test.
calibration: MT25 not separately confirmed. Pixel lengths only. User-confirmed 0.5299 pixels/um applies to20_29 and2_12.
model_status: Current automatic transitions require correction; not validated for unattended biological measurements. Model weights unchanged.
assisted_measurement_status: Existing saved Periderm polygons used to define measured regions. All six review pending.

method_settings.geometry: 8-connected skeleton with Euclidean edge lengths; tangent extension to polygon end, Savitzky-Golay51-point smoothing; native coordinates restored before length sum

roots.method: Smoothed centreline inside Gonzalo saved Periderm polygon; from its left end to right end. Annotation-assisted, not an independent manual measurement.
